lines.en: I run on two hind legs.

lines.zh: 丛林的地面在我脚下让开
lines.en: The jungle floor gives way under my feet.
My foreclaws are held up, off the ground.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴伸直，帮我转弯
lines.en: My tail straightens to help me turn.

lines.zh: 我穿过一丛蕨，蕨叶合上
lines.en: I pass through a fern and it closes.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，贴着地面跑
lines.en: I run low, hugging the ground.
My head swings side to side, watching.
One stride clears a fallen log.
I move easily between the roots.

lines.zh: 我跑起来几乎没有声音
lines.en: I run almost without sound.
I leap a small stream.

lines.zh: 我从一棵树的根间穿过
lines.en: I pass between a tree's roots.
I glance up at the canopy.
I stop, toes gripping.

lines.zh: 我站在树影里，脖子伸长
lines.en: I stand in the tree shade, neck stretched.

lines.zh: 我的前爪轻轻抓着空气
lines.en: My foreclaws close on air.
I listen while I breathe.
The jungle is full of sound.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾在地上抓了抓
lines.en: My toes grip the ground.
I tilt my head at a leaf.
My shadow is thin.

lines.zh: 我伏在蕨叶下，尾巴绷直。
lines.en: I flatten under the ferns, tail straight.
My tail tip flicks.
I lift one foot.
Birds call above the jungle.
I turn my head to a sound.

lines.zh: 我把身体贴在一根树干上
lines.en: I press against a trunk.
My ribs rise and fall under the skin.
I step out from behind the tree.

lines.zh: 我的头先动，身体才跟上
lines.en: My head moves first; the body follows.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我在算距离
lines.en: You stand still; I am measuring the distance.
My foreclaws are raised.
You are bigger than anything I have seen.
I step back, then stop.
My head tilts to one side.

lines.zh: 我从你的左侧绕到右侧
lines.en: I go from your left to your right.
I keep watching your knees.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了会引来大的
lines.en: I keep quiet; noise brings bigger things.
There is a root at your feet.
I try one small step forward.
I dart behind a tree.
I lie very low, almost flat.
One leg will not take my weight.
I breathe fast and shallow.
I flatten myself to the ground.
One of my legs jerks.
My head pulls back.
I retreat behind a tree, only my head showing.
My panting turns light and quick.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上抓了两下
lines.en: My claws scratch the ground twice.
Is that meat in your hand?
I'm watching the meat in your hand.
My head dips and rises.
I will not snatch; I wait for you to set it down.
My tail swings faster.
I sniff; it is meat.
I push my neck forward.
In the forest, five of us band together.
One lift of my head and I have it.
I carry the rest behind the tree.
You hit me and I tumble.

lines.zh: 我的身体很轻，被撞开很远
lines.en: I am light, and flung far.

lines.zh: 我一下站起来，往旁边窜
lines.en: I am up at once and dart aside.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你腿上划了一道
lines.en: My claws score your leg.
I back two steps into the brush.
You knock me half around.
My back hits a trunk.
Fourteen points, and all of it speed.
My toes slide on your shoe.
I land and dart away at once.

lines.zh: 她从树后出来，比我矮一点
lines.en: She comes from behind the tree, shorter than me.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，头一起歪
lines.en: We look at each other, heads tilting together.

lines.zh: 她的前爪搭在我的背上
lines.en: She lays a foreclaw on my back.

lines.zh: 我们一起钻进蕨丛，尾巴并排。
lines.en: We push into the ferns together, tails side by side.
Our tails touch.

lines.zh: 她替我把背上的蕨叶弄掉
lines.en: She picks a fern frond off my back.
We both lift our heads to listen.
She runs a little faster than me.
We circle each other once.

lines.zh: 我替它理了理颈后的羽。
lines.en: I preen the feathers behind its neck.
I dip my head, quickly.
I take it up and shake it twice.
I pin it under my toes.
I look around once.
I snatch it up in one bite.
There is more on the ground; I want that too.

lines.zh: 我叼着它跳上一块石头
lines.en: I carry it up onto a stone.
I hide it under the fallen leaves.
I pin it with a claw and bite down.
I carry it behind the ferns to eat.

lines.zh: 我一下停住，脚趾抓着地
lines.en: I stop short, toes gripping.
I flatten myself very low.
My head aims your way.

lines.zh: 我的后腿在蓄力，森林的落叶很滑。
lines.en: My hind legs load up; forest leaves are slick.
My head goes still.
I move one foot forward.
I drop low and break into a run.
My claws spread.
I approach from downwind.
You turn and I stop.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从下风处靠近。
lines.en: I lower myself and come in downwind.
Very little light falls on me.
My tail stays level.
My head lifts a little.
I circle you with quick small steps.

lines.zh: 林子里三到五只，个头很小。
lines.en: Three to five in the wood, and very small.
You turn; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我从树后绕向你的左边。
lines.en: I slip around the tree to your left.

lines.zh: 我贴着你侧面的蕨丛走
lines.en: I move along the ferns at your flank.
My steps come quick and short.
Each time you turn, I switch sides.
I am looking for a way in.

lines.zh: 我的影子几乎贴在地上
lines.en: My shadow lies almost on the ground.
You step back; I follow a step.
I keep shifting in small movements.
The jungle's noise covers me.
I stop at a tree's flank.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，我却看得清你
lines.en: You cannot see me, but I see you clearly.
I stay downwind of you.
I am two steps from you.
I lift a foot and set it down softly.
I dart in, claws first.
I bite and withdraw.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾蹬在你的腿上
lines.en: My toes push off your leg.
I am light, so my blows are not heavy.
I leap and bite your wrist.
My claws come down from above.
I strike, retreat, and circle back.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾蹬在你的胸口
lines.en: My toes push off your chest.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚往后拖
lines.en: I bite your hem and pull.
The strike misses; I dart behind a tree.
My head dips and lifts, fast.

lines.zh: 你的手抓到我的一只腿
lines.en: Your hand catches one of my legs.
I use my tail to keep balance.
I lunge again from another side.

lines.zh: 我的前爪在你膝上停了一瞬
lines.en: My foreclaws rest on your knee a moment.

lines.zh: 你退开，我在你身后落地
lines.en: You pull back; I land behind you.
The ferns stir first.
I slip out from under the leaves.

lines.zh: 我从蕨叶间探出头，四下看。
lines.en: I poke my head through the ferns and scan.
I stop, toes gripping the soil.

lines.zh: 丛林里多了一个细长的影子
lines.en: A thin shadow has joined the jungle.
The leaf litter is pushed aside first.
I come out from beneath the fern's roots.
My head sweeps left and right.
My toes grip the wet soil.
I stop beside a tree.

lines.zh: 丛林的光落在我的背上
lines.en: Jungle light falls on my back.
My tail is held level.
I move, and the leaves around me sound.
I turn half my body.
My head turns twice.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾在土里按出印
lines.en: My toes press marks into the soil.

lines.zh: 火一碰到我，我窜出去很远
lines.en: Fire touches me and I bolt far away.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，翻了两圈
lines.en: I fall from the tree, tumbling twice.

lines.zh: 水没到我的背，我拼命蹬
lines.en: Water reaches my back and I kick hard.
The blast throws me into the ferns.
Something grazes my ribs.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的腿一时僵住
lines.en: That force locks my legs a moment.

lines.zh: 我瘦得只剩骨头，跑不快
lines.en: I am down to bones and cannot run fast.
The thunder clap flattens me.

lines.zh: 地面没有了，我一路往下掉
lines.en: The ground is gone; I fall and fall.
